title: Write unit tests for caffeinate.ts
description: Create Vitest unit tests for the caffeinate module using platform and child_process mocking.
acceptanceCriteria: start() on darwin spawns caffeinate -i test passes
start() on linux returns null test passes
stop() with a process calls kill() test passes
stop(null) is a no-op test passes
npm test passes all caffeinate.test.ts cases

steps.details: Create the test file. Import vi from vitest for mocking. Import start, stop from caffeinate.ts.
Use vi.stubGlobal('process', { ...process, platform: 'darwin' }) for macOS tests. Restore after each test with vi.unstubAllGlobals().
Use vi.mock('child_process', () => ({ spawn: vi.fn().mockReturnValue({ kill: vi.fn(), on: vi.fn() }) })). Verify spawn is called with ('caffeinate', ['-i']) on darwin.

steps.description: Write all test cases and run
steps.details: Write all 4 test cases. Run `npm test` and verify all pass.

technicalNotes: Vitest's vi.mock() must be called at the top level of the test file, not inside describe blocks
vi.stubGlobal is the correct way to mock process.platform in Vitest
